description: She wears a deep purple floor-length noble gown with a low square neckline, a fitted structured bodice and narrow decorated shoulder panels secured with round gold-toned brooches. Gold-colored geometric woven bands run around the neckline and waist and down the front and hem. A cream-and-purple bordered wrap rests around the forearms and hangs loosely beside the skirt; it partly obscures the gown's sleeve construction. A cream underdress panel and patterned gold-and-purple closed shoe show at the lower front. She also wears small drop earrings, a jeweled pendant necklace and rings. Opaque textured fabrics cover the bust, abdomen and pelvis while upper chest and shoulders are exposed.
